description:
Use this when you need an auditable nationwide Uzbekistan 2026 result and know the workweek variant. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when workweek is unknown, or the roster is continuous, shift-based, employer-specific, bank, school or sector-specific.
What it computes: Checks a date against Uzbekistan's 2026 statutory holidays and the selected five-day or six-day workweek transfer schedule.
Example user requests: Is 2026-12-31 a working day in Uzbekistan for a five-day workweek? | Check 2026-05-30 for a six-day workweek.
Inputs: date (date); workweek (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-12-31","workweek":5} | {"date":"2026-05-30","workweek":6}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, workweek, weekly_rest_model, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, weekend_days, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: apply selected weekly-rest baseline, statutory events and PF-257 workweek-specific transfers
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/uzbekistan-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/uzbekistan-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in the pinned 2026 coverage.

workweek.description: Required official schedule variant: 5 for Saturday-Sunday rest, or 6 for Sunday-only rest.

name: check_uzbekistan_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Nationwide 2026 statutory and PF-257 schedule scope.

day_type.description: Official weekend, statutory holiday, additional rest, transferred rest, special working day or regular workday.

holiday_names.description: Official events applying on the date.

is_working_day.description: Whether the date is working under the selected official workweek variant.

substitute_day_policy.description: Published transfers only; no employer/shift inference.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Uzbekistan Working Day
